symbols.name: ground set size
symbols.meaning: The number of elements of the ground set, from which the three-element subsets are taken.
symbols.quote: Let $[h]=\{1,\dots,h\}$, where $h$ is the number of elements of the ground set.

symbols.name: three-element subsets
symbols.meaning: The set of all three-element subsets of $[h]$.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal T$ be the set of all such subsets.

symbols.name: bank index
symbols.meaning: A triple of subsets $a=(a_1,a_2,a_3)$ that indexes each value of the two banks.
symbols.quote: Two data banks $X_a$ and $Y_a$ are indexed by $a=(a_1,a_2,a_3)\in\mathcal T^3$.

symbols.name: data bank X
symbols.meaning: The first data bank, holding one value for each index $a$.
symbols.quote: Two data banks $X_a$ and $Y_a$ are indexed by $a=(a_1,a_2,a_3)\in\mathcal T^3$.

symbols.name: data bank Y
symbols.meaning: The second data bank, holding one value for each index $a$.
symbols.quote: Two data banks $X_a$ and $Y_a$ are indexed by $a=(a_1,a_2,a_3)\in\mathcal T^3$.

symbols.name: subset T
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of $[h]$ used as a varying coordinate, not the linear map of the earlier page.
symbols.quote: Here $T$ denotes a three-element subset of $[h]$, not the earlier linear map.

symbols.name: subset S
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of $[h]$ used as the varying target coordinate of an invocation.
symbols.quote: A forward invocation takes controls $x_T$ and targets $y_S$, where $S,T\in\mathcal T$.

symbols.name: control value
symbols.meaning: The control value on the wires of subset $T$ in a forward invocation.
symbols.quote: A forward invocation takes controls $x_T$ and targets $y_S$, where $S,T\in\mathcal T$.

symbols.name: target value
symbols.meaning: The target value on the wires of subset $S$ in a forward invocation.
symbols.quote: A forward invocation takes controls $x_T$ and targets $y_S$, where $S,T\in\mathcal T$.

symbols.name: scratch wire
symbols.meaning: The scratch wire for the ordered neighbor pair $(S,T)$.
symbols.quote: For each ordered neighbor pair $(S,T)$ there is a scratch wire $A_{ST}$, and for each $i\in[h]$ a central wire $C_i$.

symbols.name: central wire
symbols.meaning: The central wire for the ground element $i$.
symbols.quote: For each ordered neighbor pair $(S,T)$ there is a scratch wire $A_{ST}$, and for each $i\in[h]$ a central wire $C_i$.

symbols.name: initial scratch values A
symbols.meaning: The initial values of the scratch wires $A_{ST}$.
symbols.quote: Let $p$ and $q$ be the initial values of the $A_{ST}$ and $C_i$.

symbols.name: initial scratch values C
symbols.meaning: The initial values of the central wires $C_i$.
symbols.quote: Let $p$ and $q$ be the initial values of the $A_{ST}$ and $C_i$.

relations.quote: The network is a linear operator in [Linear algebra over a field](linear-algebra.md).
It has the fixed structure of a [Fixed-tape machine model](fixed-tape-machine.md): its wires and schedule do not depend on the values.
